lex:
τελεσφορέω, -ῶ
(τέλος, φέρω) [in LXX: 4Ma.13:20 * ;]
__(a) of plants, to bring fruit to perfection (Theophr.): Luk.8:14
__(b) of females, to bear perfect offspring (Artemid.; 4Mac, l.with).†

strongs.def: to be a bearer to completion (maturity), i.e. to ripen fruit (figuratively)
strongs.from: from a compound of G5056 (τέλος) and G5342 (φέρω)
